    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Avalonia中的动画</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文讲述了在Avalonia中实现自定义动画以及离散动画的方法。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
作者：王先荣<br><strong>内置动画</strong>
在Avalonia中，常用的动画有以下几种：关键帧动画（KeyFrame Animation）、过渡动画（Transition Animation）和合成动画（Composition Animations）。它们在使用方式和适用场景有所不同，官方文档的总结如下表所示（https://docs.avaloniaui.net/docs/graphics-animation/animations）。
<table style="width: 1024px" border="0" align="left">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>
<pre>Type</pre>
</td>
<td>
<pre>Description</pre>
</td>
<td>
<pre>Use case</pre>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<pre>Keyframe Animations</pre>
</td>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Change one or more properties over a timeline with multiple keyframes.</pre>
</td>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Complex, multi-step animations triggered by style selectors.</pre>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Control Transitions</pre>
</td>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Animate a single property when its value changes.</pre>
</td>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Smooth visual feedback for property changes (opacity, color, size).</pre>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Composition Animations</pre>
</td>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Code-driven animations that run on the render thread.</pre>
</td>
<td>&nbsp;
<pre>Performance-sensitive or programmatic animations controlled from C#.</pre>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
严格来说，它们都是插值动画（Interpolated Animations）。那么怎样才能实现离散动画呢？例如打字机效果的动画，游戏中的精灵动画。 <strong>Avalonia官方的自定义动画示例</strong> Avalonia的官方示例项目（RenderDemo https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/tree/master/samples/RenderDemo）中，实现了一个名为CustomStringAnimator（https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/blob/master/samples/RenderDemo/Pages/CustomStringAnimator.cs）的动画类，它继承自InterpolatingAnimator&lt;string&gt;，并重写了Interpolate方法来实现打字机效果的动画。以下是该动画类的代码：
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img id="code_img_closed_aaeb97b4-3e48-4d56-bb96-85adebaf169d" class="code_img_closed lazyload" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif"><img id="code_img_opened_aaeb97b4-3e48-4d56-bb96-85adebaf169d" class="code_img_opened lazyload" style="display: none" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_aaeb97b4-3e48-4d56-bb96-85adebaf169d" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> CustomStringAnimator : InterpolatingAnimator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Interpolate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> progress, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> oldValue, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (newValue.Length == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> step = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.0</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue.Length;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> length = (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>)(progress /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = newValue.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, length + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">自定义动画</span></div>
<br>使用起来跟普通的动画几乎一样，需要指定Animator，代码如下（https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/blob/master/samples/RenderDemo/Pages/CustomAnimatorPage.xaml）：
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img id="code_img_closed_335d228d-45dc-4503-aa31-93ee7dcef3a3" class="code_img_closed lazyload" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif"><img id="code_img_opened_335d228d-45dc-4503-aa31-93ee7dcef3a3" class="code_img_opened lazyload" style="display: none" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_335d228d-45dc-4503-aa31-93ee7dcef3a3" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">HorizontalAlignment</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Center"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> VerticalAlignment</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Center"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock.Styles</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Selector</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="TextBlock"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style.Animations</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Duration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="0:0:1"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> IterationCount</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Infinite"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Cue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="0%"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Property</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Text"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> Value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">=""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pages:CustomStringAnimator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>

          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Cue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="100%"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>

<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">View Code</span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
值得注意的是在axaml中使用自定义动画器时，需要指定动画器的类型（&lt;Animation.Animator&gt;&lt;pages:CustomStringAnimator/&gt;&lt;/Animation.Animator&gt;），否则会报错。 <strong>改进的字符串动画</strong> 在官方示例的基础上，我们可以略微做一些改进：支持在字符串之间进行插值动画。动画过程中会根据进度逐渐显示新字符串的内容，同时保留旧字符串的公共前缀部分。
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> StringAnimator : InterpolatingAnimator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算插值结果。
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="progress"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">进度：0到1之间的值，指在两个关键帧之间过渡的时间位置。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="oldValue"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">旧值：动画开始时，第一个关键帧的值。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="newValue"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">新值：动画结束时，最后一个关键帧的值。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">返回插值结果。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Interpolate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> progress, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> oldValue, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (progress &lt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> oldValue;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (progress &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> oldLength = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrEmpty(oldValue) ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : oldValue.Length;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> newLength = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrEmpty(newValue) ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : newValue.Length;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (oldLength == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; newLength == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (oldLength == newLength &amp;&amp; oldValue ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (oldLength == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newValue.StartsWith(oldValue))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果旧值为空或新值以旧值开头，则从旧值开始插入新值的剩余部分</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> newValue.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>)(oldLength + (newLength - oldLength) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> progress));
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (newLength == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> oldValue.StartsWith(newValue))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果新值为空或旧值以新值开头，则从新值开始删除旧值的剩余部分</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> oldValue.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>)(newLength + (oldLength - newLength) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> progress)));
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">如果没有包含关系，忽略旧值，直接从新值开始插入</span>
            oldLength = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> newValue.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>)(oldLength + (newLength - oldLength) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> progress));
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringAnimator()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注册动画器</span>
        Animation.RegisterCustomAnimator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, StringAnimator&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
使用方法跟官方示例一样。 <strong>自定义离散动画</strong> 如果要实现通用的离散动画，该怎么实现呢？跟上面类似，我们可以从InterpolatingAnimator&lt;T&gt;继承一个DiscreteAnimator&lt;T&gt;类，代码很简单，放弃中间的过渡部分，直接在进度达到100%时切换到新值，代码如下：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> DiscreteAnimator&lt;T&gt; : InterpolatingAnimator&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> T Interpolate(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> progress, T oldValue, T newValue)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> progress &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> oldValue : newValue;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DiscreteAnimator()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注册动画器</span>
        Animation.RegisterCustomAnimator&lt;T, DiscreteAnimator&lt;T&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
使用方法跟上面一样：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Text</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="离散动画器文本，切换几种不同的样式。"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock.Styles</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Selector</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="TextBlock"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style.Animations</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Duration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="0:0:3"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> IterationCount</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Infinite"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> PlaybackDirection</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Alternate"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Cue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="0%"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Property</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="FontStyle"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> Value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Normal"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">app:DiscreteAnimator </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">x:TypeArguments</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="FontStyle"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Cue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="30%"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Property</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="FontStyle"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> Value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Italic"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">app:DiscreteAnimator </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">x:TypeArguments</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="FontStyle"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Cue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="60%"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Property</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="FontStyle"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> Value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Oblique"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">app:DiscreteAnimator </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">x:TypeArguments</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="FontStyle"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation.Animator</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setter</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KeyFrame</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animation</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style.Animations</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock.Styles</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TextBlock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
因为我们使用了泛型，在指定动画器时需要使用x:TypeArguments来指定类型参数（&lt;app:DiscreteAnimator x:TypeArguments="FontStyle" /&gt;），否则会报错。 <strong>另一种实现自定义动画的变通方法</strong> 如果不想实现通用的动画器，我们可以注册AvaloniaProperty，并在属性的PropertyChanged回调中直接修改属性值来实现动画效果。以下是一个简单的示例，演示如何通过注册一个名为DiscreteValue的AvaloniaProperty来实现几何路径变换的动画：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">注册一个AvaloniaProperty，类型为int，默认值为0</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> DISCRETE_VALUE = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DiscreteValue</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> StyledProperty&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; DiscreteValueProperty =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    AvaloniaProperty.Register</span>&lt;Path, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(DISCRETE_VALUE, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">定义一个数组，存储不同的几何路径，在动画过程中根据DiscreteValue的值来切换不同的路径</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> PathGeometry[] bells = [];      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">这里省略了路径的定义
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">创建一个动画并运行它</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> PlayAnimation_Click(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sender, Avalonia.Interactivity.RoutedEventArgs e)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> animation = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Animation()
    {
        Duration </span>= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        IterationCount </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> IterationCount(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        PlaybackDirection </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PlaybackDirection.Alternate,
        Children </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KeyFrame()
            {
                Setters </span>= { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Setter(DiscreteValueProperty, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), },
                KeyTime </span>= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KeyFrame()
            {
                Setters </span>= { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Setter(DiscreteValueProperty, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), },
                KeyTime </span>= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KeyFrame()
            {
                Setters </span>= { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Setter(DiscreteValueProperty, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), },
                KeyTime </span>= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KeyFrame()
            {
                Setters </span>= { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Setter(DiscreteValueProperty, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), },
                KeyTime </span>= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KeyFrame()
            {
                Setters </span>= { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Setter(DiscreteValueProperty, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), },
                KeyTime </span>= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            }
        }
    };
    _ </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> animation.RunAsync(Path1);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在属性的PropertyChanged事件中，根据DiscreteValue的值来切换不同的路径</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Path1_PropertyChanged(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sender, Avalonia.AvaloniaPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.Property.Name ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DiscreteValueProperty.Name)
    {
        Debug.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">time: {DateTime.Now}, Path1 property changed: {e.Property.Name}, old value: {e.OldValue}, new value: {e.NewValue}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> value = (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)e.NewValue;
        Path1.Data </span>= bells[value %<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bells.Length];
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
这种方法只能在代码中调用，无法在axaml中使用，但它不需要实现通用的动画器，适合一些特定的动画效果。 本文相关代码可以在我的Gitee仓库中找到： https://gitee.com/xrwang2/avalonia-test/tree/master/AvaloniaMvvpDesktopApp

</div>
